items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Max Roach was in there, all kinds of people.

ctx.x: I’m trying to get this straight in my mind. I went with Delauney to meet Bird. Of course this was a dream, Charlie Parker. I loved all of his stuff. Through Klook, I learned more and more and more. I always had a good ear, because I think that’s the base, listening. I listened to everything I could get my hands on. I remember the first time I heard Dizzy’s Things to Come, I said, “Wait a minute. Play that again.” I couldn’t believe what I was hearing. We came back, Bird and I. Went back to the apartment. Janis…
